name: Contract Triage by Task Group
description: Legal triages each contract the workflow starts on. Find Document puts the incoming contract in a Document variable. A Choice task goes to the Legal task group (the person who started the workflow is its Task Group Assignee): Needs edits sends the contract to an Edit Document task, Ready to file ends the run. The workflow output says which path the contract took.

steps.name: Legal triage
steps.instructions: Read the contract. Choose Needs edits if the wording must change before it is filed, or Ready to file.
steps.subject: Triage <%#XmlVariables.Params.Documents.Document.Name%>

steps.name: Edit the contract
steps.instructions: Make the changes in the contract (upload a new version or edit it online), then complete the task.
